knownGapsDisclosed: The pre-signature confirmation prompt in po-human-approval.mjs is English-only and does not follow runtime.humanFacingLanguage.
sign-intent's confirmation summary names only the intent digest and a generic consequence class; it cannot describe the specific action.
An absent --runner still resolves silently to codex in project-onboarding-v3.mjs; the correction was implemented and reverted twice.
Commit 5efb0f1's Dispatch trailer names one dispatch while its diff carries production changes from two, caused by a shared-checkout index race.
Maintenance-window scope selectivity is not asserted by any test at either library or hook level, though it was verified empirically against a live window.
GUARD-CROSS-REPO-MUTATION blocks writes to the session's harness-assigned scratchpad directory and has no lift by design.
One grammar denial against a path outside the repository root was observed without the new override-route block; not yet diagnosed.
excludedFromReview: Documentation-only, backlog and evidence-relocation commits in the same range are not part of the enumerated review object.
